attacks.name: Razor Wing Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Toxic Flechettes|: After this attack is resolved, for each |!wild| in the attack roll, the defender gains 1 of the following special conditions: |§bleed§Bleed| or |§poison§Poison|.
|!critical| |*Overwing|: After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.

attacks.name: Avatar of Death
steps: |!wild| |*Neurotoxin|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition. If the defender has the |§bleed§Bleed| and |§poison§Poison| special conditions, and it does not have an Activated token, it gains an Activated token instead of gaining the Stagger special condition.

superPowers.name: Charge
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Wing Shield
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by a |!physical| or |!energy| attack or is making a dodge roll, it may use this superpower. Add 2 dice to this character's defense or dodge roll.

superPowers.name: Chosen of Apocalypse
superPowers.body: When this character makes an attack, it may change 1 die result to a |!hit| for each |!wild| in the attack roll.
